monitoring.delete_all_venvs_confirmation: Are you sure you want to delete all virtual environments ? This will completely clear the virtual environments folder.

monitoring.clean_lab_confirmation: This will clean all unused data from the lab. It will remove the temporary files and shadow resources (resources that were not correctly deleted). It can only be executed if there is no waiting or running scenario. It might take a few minutes.
monitoring.bricks_data_help: Here is the list of external files and folders downloaded by tasks.

monitoring.all_brick_data_deleted: All bricks data have been deleted
monitoring.app_stop_process_confirmation: Are you sure you want to stop this app ? The app will automatically restart when requested.
monitoring.app_stop_all_processus_confirmation: Are you sure you want to stop all apps ? The apps are automatically restarted when requested.
monitoring.app_stop_policy_tooltip: Auto: the app is stopped when no connections are detected and will restart on next access. Manual: the app stays alive until explicitly stopped from this section.
monitoring.app_custom_subdomain_help: Set a readable, stable subdomain for this app. It must be unique across all apps in the lab. The new host takes effect on the next start of the app.
monitoring.app_custom_subdomain_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Must start and end with a letter or digit.
monitoring.app_custom_subdomain_invalid: Invalid subdomain. Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
monitoring.app_custom_subdomain_set: Custom subdomain set. It will take effect on the next start of the app.
monitoring.app_custom_subdomain_cleared: Custom subdomain cleared. The default host will be used on the next start of the app.
monitoring.clean_invalid_share_links: Delete invalid share links (links where share object was delete)
monitoring.start_error_description: The lab encountered errors during startup. Click the button below to view the error logs.
monitoring.claude_plugin_title: Connect Claude Code to this lab
monitoring.claude_plugin_lead: Claude Code can use this lab's tools directly — read its databases, and whatever else the installed bricks expose. Install the plugin this lab serves.
monitoring.claude_plugin_update_claude: Update it if it is older
monitoring.claude_plugin_step_1_hint: You only ever do this once, the address never changes.
monitoring.claude_plugin_step_2_hint: Or run /plugin and pick {{plugin}} from the list.
monitoring.claude_plugin_step_3_hint: Restart Claude Code when it asks, then run /mcp and approve the access in the browser window that opens. The tools appear once you have.
monitoring.claude_plugin_update_intro: The version moves whenever this lab's tools or skills change. To pull an update, run these two commands:
monitoring.claude_plugin_404_hint: If a download answers 404, your copy of the marketplace is older than the lab: run those two commands and install again.
monitoring.claude_plugin_disabled: Claude Code cannot connect to this lab.
monitoring.claude_plugin_disabled_description: Its MCP server is turned off, so there is nothing to connect to and no plugin to install. A lab administrator can enable it.
monitoring.claude_plugin_url_not_supported: Install this lab's plugin from a local folder
monitoring.claude_plugin_url_not_supported_descript: Claude Code refuses a plugin archive that is not served over https:// from a public host, and this lab is reachable at {{url}}. This is normal on a development lab: install the plugin from a local folder instead, by running the script below on your own machine.
monitoring.claude_plugin_dev_step_1: Step 1 — run this one command on your own machine
monitoring.claude_plugin_dev_step_1_hint: Then follow the instructions the command prints in your terminal.
monitoring.claude_plugin_dev_step_2_hint: There is nothing to paste: the script registers the marketplace and installs the plugin itself, then names the version it installed. Restart Claude Code to load it, then run /mcp and approve the access in the browser window that opens.
monitoring.claude_plugin_dev_update_hint: A local install never updates itself. Whenever this lab's tools or skills change, run the same command again — it refreshes the local marketplace and reinstalls the plugin.
